run.name: Primo Brands Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (PRMB)
run.summary: Primo Brands has ample liquidity, rising cash flow and a term loan due in 2031, but leverage leans on management add-backs, shareholder returns continue, and the 2028 and 2029 notes are the next refinancing test. The view is moderately cautious. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, company definition, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Q3 release `page:14`: debt excluding unamortized costs 5,249.7 US$m, unrestricted cash 477.2 US$m, TTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,436.1 US$m; net ratio as printed, gross ratio derived. On unadjusted LTM EBITDA of 1,209.1 US$m the ratios are 4.34x and 3.95x. Not a covenant ratio

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 1,436.1 US$m over LTM cash interest of 298.7 US$m (303.1 less 204.8 plus 200.4, `page:7` of the Q3 10-Q and 10-K `page:128`). On unadjusted LTM EBITDA of 1,209.1 US$m the ratio is 4.05x. Not the covenant definition

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash (477.4 less 0.2 restricted, `page:51`). Revolver 750.0 less letters of credit of 163.4 (`page:51`); revolver loans not itemized, assumed nil from the phrase "undrawn availability" (`page:50`). Revolver matures February 2030 with an undefined springing maturity; no facility expires within twelve months

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, continuing, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.

CP-2 main limitation: Covenant ratios, the executed credit documents, the stockholders agreement and the current sponsor holding are not supplied, so headroom and distribution limits cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: Leverage rests on management Adjusted EBITDA; covenant ratios, executed credit documents and a filed post-refinancing debt schedule are not in the pack.
